shaders.note: weather radar plan view (optional: skipped where the source isn't present); -pack-optimized lets it link with the game's vertex shader

patches.note: the transmittance LUT: our medium, the daylight white balance (C22) on its output; on capture: dumps the SkyAtmosphere constants (region A)
the multiple-scattering LUT: our medium; its 20 march segments spaced quadratically and its rows quadratic in height, so that a dense haze keeps its own colour (dust, smoke)

the sky-view LUT: our medium and aerosol phase; the haze field: each march sample's haze from the METAR stations around (HAZE_ROWS); reads the multiple-scattering LUT's quadratic rows; its 40 march segments spaced quadratically

the aerial-perspective volume: our medium and aerosol phase, the far-slice stretch (T12); on capture: dumps its constants (region B); the haze field: each march sample's haze from the METAR stations around (HAZE_ROWS); reads the multiple-scattering LUT's quadratic rows; each cell's optical depth per colour, for the clouds' haze colour (CAMVOL_TINT_REGION)

the far cloud layer's atmosphere map: our medium and aerosol phase; the haze field: each march sample's haze from the METAR stations around (HAZE_ROWS); reads the multiple-scattering LUT's quadratic rows

per-pixel aerial perspective on deferred surfaces (terrain, buildings); the haze field: each march sample's haze from the METAR stations around (HAZE_ROWS); reads the multiple-scattering LUT's quadratic rows

per-channel aerial-perspective transmittance on volumetric clouds (T11), a forward lobe in their sun/moon phase, multiple scattering, build-up of bounced light, crisper edges, a glory and the aircraft's shadow from ch_deferred_shadows' window, else a drawn silhouette (C0-C15)

every frame (DebugCapture bit 4): copies a window of the sun's shadow map around the camera (the aircraft, when Raytraced Shadows are off) into the debug buffer for the clouds' aircraft shadow; on capture: dumps the shadow-map constants, the cascades and its output; output unchanged
on capture only: dumps its screen-space shadow mask (every 8th pixel) and pass parameters (aircraft-shadow analysis); output unchanged
on capture only: dumps its output (every 8th pixel); output unchanged
the weather volume generator; on capture only (16 MB debug buffer): dumps its constants, weather maps, shape noise, coverage curve, precipitation maps and output; output unchanged

environment cubemap: inline aerial perspective on its terrain and clouds, which feeds the sky-light SH (cloud and scene ambient) and reflections; the haze field: each march sample's haze from the METAR stations around (HAZE_ROWS); reads the multiple-scattering LUT's quadratic rows

the clouds' composite: records its factor from the clouds' colour to the scene's (FOG_SCALE) and the fog's colour on a coarse grid over the screen (FOG_GRID), for the forward pass's fog; output unchanged

the forward pass (glass, fan and propeller discs, light glows, the refraction buffer), drawn after the clouds: the fog around the camera (the cloud renderer's record, the merge's fog colour) by the view depth along the ray, by the pipeline's target and blending (the add-on: the scene colour or the refraction buffer only); only elements in the world (those MSFS fades by its cloud frustum volume)
particles (exhaust, smoke, spray), drawn after the clouds: the forward pass's fog (patch_forward_fog)
light points (aircraft, runway and approach lights), drawn after the clouds: dimmed by the fog over the light's own distance (additive)
city and ground lights, drawn after the clouds: dimmed by the fog over the light's own distance (additive)
